profile.headline: Software Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with over five years of experience. I currently work at API SA for Playtika, a leading in mobile game industry, in developing high-performance data pipelines, streaming solutions, and machine learning applications using Scala, Spark, Akka, Python. 

My mission is to leverage my skills and expertise in programming, machine learning engineering, streaming and big data, to deliver scalable, reliable, and innovative solutions that meet the needs and expectations of our clients. 

I enjoy working in a multicultural and agile environment, where I can collaborate with other engineers, data scientists, and stakeholders, and constantly learn new technologies and best practices. 

I am always looking for new challenges and opportunities to grow as a professional and as a person.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and develop an experimental pipeline for document processing and automatic reply generation. Scanning/OCR with PyTesseract, text classification with BERT family models, text generation with decoder models like Llama2 and Mixtral in local with Ollama. 
•	Evaluate different architectures and techniques like RAG, vector databases like ChromaDBC, Prompt Engineering, Few-shot learning and Entity Recognition / Extraction.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
As Machine Learning Engineer my tasks where:
• Working in the MLOps platform (Java, Python, BentoML) for the standardization of pipeline management and Machine Learning service for Data Scientists.
• Working in the planning, execution and analysis pipeline of A/B testing experiments, definition and improvement of Airflow tasks (Python, Airflow, Kubernetes). Execution and monitor of pipelines in production. Improve test coverage.
•  Full re-implementation for scalability of significance tests for A/B test analyses (Python, Scala)

positions.title: Software Engineer / Developer / Data Engineer
positions.description:
Software engineer in the team of Data Engineers providing a streaming solution for Data
Science.

Writed complex Java and Scala code for high performance data pipelines written on top of Akka streams and Akka actors. These tasks included:
• Writing pipeline elements with Akka streams and Akka actors
• Having to use object oriented and functional programming oriented patterns
• Having to use functional entities such as Monads (using the Vavr library when developing in
Java)
• Working with Kafka consumers and producers
• Understanding how Prometheus counters works for fined grained monitoring of the code
• Following development best practices by achieving high unit test coverage of his code
• Working in the agile SCRUM methodology

Developed complex validation and healthcheck logic, also in Java and Scala. These tasks included:
• Working with design patterns to allow an extensible and robust validation design
• Working with more advanced Kafka concepts and the basic of development for Kubernetes
for application health check

positions.title: Big Data Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development of data pipelines in different projects:
- Integrate different sources and organize piece parts for Maintenance Resource Management system
and demand prediction for aerospace equipment industry.
- Data pipeline ingestion and anomaly detection for assurance company.
- Identity Protection for data analysis pipeline in bank institution.
- Scala, Spark, Databricks, Azure, Data Factory, Cosmos DB, Neo4j, Hadoop Hortonworks,
Cloudera, Nifi, Zeppelin,Hive, Hbase, Hive,

positions.title: Scala backend engineer
positions.description: Contributed to a distributed and scalable platform to control and optimize fleets of driverless vehicles in real time (Scala, Akka-http, graphQL/Sangria, Kafka, Docker.)

positions.title: Graduate Student
positions.description: Trained in topics of Big Data, Machine Learning and Stream Processing algorithms and techniques using technologies like Scala, Spark, ElasticSearch, Kafka, Python ecosystem (NumPy, Pandas, Cython,) AWS, Ansible and Docker.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Contributed to the development of Sicpa’s core platform for product control, authentication and
track & trace solution for governments.
● Integrated the developer’s test environment with Vagrant, Ansible and VirtualBox in a DevOps
system using vSphere.
● Developed and tested new features on the server backend (J2EE, JBoss5, Linux, PostgreSQL,
Oracle.)
● Participated in the development and testing of client applications (J2SE, Swing, JUnit and Spring
core frameworks). These applications involved soft real-time constraints, multithreading and commu-
nication with multiple devices (PL Controller, Cameras, Sensors) in an industrial environment.
● Participated in some projects to customize, test and on site deploy the solution.
● Definition of testing procedures and test performance in collaboration with QA department.
● Collaborated with QA department for the definition of testing procedures and performance.
● Developed a proof of concept of a client application with OSGi and Guice frameworks.

positions.title: Software developer
positions.description:
I worked in the front-end and back-end parts of a tax processing tool for Madrid city council.
● Working with J(2)EE technology (e.g. JSP, Hibernate, Struts, JBoss, etc.)
●Automated scripting to generate datamodels (internally developed scripting.)
● Interaction and know-how sharing with testing engineers.
